title: French Beef Casserole
description: A hearty French-inspired beef casserole with tender beef and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and mustard. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
